FROM rust:1-slim AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY Cargo.toml Cargo.lock ./
RUN mkdir src && echo 'fn main(){}' > src/main.rs && cargo build --release && rm -rf src target/release/{{binary_name}}*
COPY . .
RUN cargo build --release

FROM gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian12
COPY --from=build /src/target/release/{{binary_name}} /{{binary_name}}
ENTRYPOINT ["/{{binary_name}}"]
